assessmentQuestionVersion.name: SWS_RiskAssessment_Q3
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: Source water (select based on the highest risk source)
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Surface water: Water which is open to the atmosphere and includes streams, lakes, rivers, creeks, springs and rainwater. GARP — at risk of containing pathogens: Groundwater determined by a Drinking Water Officer (DWO) to be likely contaminated by pathogens including bacteria, viruses and protozoa, either continuously or intermittently. GARP — viruses only: Groundwater determined by a DWO to be at risk of containing viruses only, where the source is located within 300 m of a probable enteric viral contamination source without a barrier to viral transport. Bulk water (hauled from permitted water source): Water supplied to the system from an off-site source, delivered either by vehicle transport (hauling). Bulk water (piped): Water supplied to the system from an off-site source, delivered either by pipeline. Groundwater at low risk of containing pathogens (Non-GARP): Groundwater determined by a DWO to have no hazards present, or all identified hazards confirmed as low risk.
